newsitem.title: UK: Branson planning to float Virgin Rail - paper.
newsitem.headline: Branson planning to float Virgin Rail - paper.

text.p: British entrepreneur Richard Branson is planning to float Virgin Rail, a division of Branson's Virgin Group, on the stock market, the Guardian newspaper said on Tuesday.

The newspaper quoted Will Whitehorn, a director of Virgin Rail, as saying the flotation would probably be early next year and would release considerable amounts of money "which we think would help develop one of the most important parts of the rail system."
Under the deal at least 25 percent of Virgin Rail would be sold to the public with the rest made available to private companies and institutions, said the Guardian.
City sources suggested in the newspaper that a float of Virgin Rail would be valued at around 250 million pounds ($401.5 million).

Branson was awarded a 15-year franchise to operate Britain's InterCity West Coast (ICWC) rail services between London and Scotland in February, adding to the Cross Country franchise awarded last November. ($ = 0.622 British Pounds)
